name: Tohokushinsha Film Corporation
summary: Tohokushinsha Film Corporation engages in television distribution business in Japan. It operates through four segments: Advertising Production, Content Production, Media, and Properties. The company engages in creating a range of advertising videos, including TV commercials, web videos, music videos, social media advertisements, digital signage, and branding videos; promotion planning/production; feature films, television series, animations, and games; production of theatrical feature films and drama series; development and production of TV programming and video content; post-production services, such as video editing, audio editing, color grading, visual composition, and generation of subti…
